verses.id-skb: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huw, al-ḥayyul-qayyūm, lā ta'khużuhū sinatuw walā naum, lahū mā fis-samāwāti wamā fil-arḍ, man żal-lażī yasyfa‘u ‘indahū illā bi'iżnih, ya‘lamu mā baina aidīhim wamā khalfahum, walā yuḥīṭūna bisyai'im min ‘ilmihī illā bimā syā', wasi‘a kursiyyuhus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, walā ya'ūduhū ḥifẓuhumā, wahuwal-‘aliyyul-‘aẓīm.
verses.en: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huw, al-ḥayyul-qayyūm, lā taʾkhudhuhū sinatuw walā nawm, lahū mā fis-samāwāti wamā fil-arḍ, man dhal-ladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahū illā biʾidhnih, yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum, walā yuḥīṭūna bishayʾim min ʿilmihī illā bimā shāʾ, wasiʿa kursiyyuhus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, walā yaʾūduhū ḥifẓuhumā, wahuwal-ʿaliyyul-ʿaẓīm
verses.en-simple: Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huw, al-hayyul-qayyoom, laa ta'khudhuhoo sinatuw walaa nawm, lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, man dhal-ladhee yashfa`u `indahoo illaa bi'idhnih, ya`lamu maa bayna aydeehim wamaa khalfahum, walaa yuheetoona bishay'im min `ilmihee illaa bimaa shaa', wasi`a kursiyyuhus-samaawaati wal-ard, walaa ya'ooduhoo hifzuhumaa, wahuwal-`aliyyul-`azeem

verses.id-skb: Waminan-nāsi may yaqūlu āmannā billāhi wabil-yaumil-ākhiri wamā hum bimu'minīn.
verses.en: Waminan-nāsi may yaqūlu āmannā billāhi wabil-yawmil-ākhiri wamā hum bimuʾminīn
verses.en-simple: Waminan-naasi may yaqoolu aamannaa billaahi wabil-yawmil-aakhiri wamaa hum bimu'mineen

verses.id-skb: Yu'til-ḥikmata may yasyā', wamay yu'tal-ḥikmata faqad ūtiya khairan kaṡīrā, wamā yażżakkaru illā ulul-albāb.
verses.en: Yuʾtil-ḥikmata may yashāʾ, wamay yuʾtal-ḥikmata faqad ūtiya khayran kathīrā, wamā yadhdhakkaru illā ulul-albāb
verses.en-simple: Yu'til-hikmata may yashaa', wamay yu'tal-hikmata faqad ootiya khayran katheeraa, wamaa yadhdhakkaru illaa ulul-albaab

verses.id-skb: Awa‘ajibtum an jā'akum żikrum mir rabbikum ‘alā rajulim minkum liyunżirakum, ważkurū iż ja‘alakum khulafā'a mim ba‘di qaumi nūḥiw wazādakum fil-khalqi basṭah, fażkurū ālā'allāhi la‘allakum tufliḥūn.
verses.en: Awaʿajibtum an jāʾakum dhikrum mir rabbikum ʿalā rajulim minkum liyundhirakum, wadhkurū idh jaʿalakum khulafāʾa mim baʿdi qawmi nūḥiw wazādakum fil-khalqi basṭah, fadhkurū ālāʾallāhi laʿallakum tufliḥūn
verses.en-simple: Awa`ajibtum an jaa'akum dhikrum mir rabbikum `alaa rajulim minkum liyundhirakum, wadhkuroo idh ja`alakum khulafaa'a mim ba`di qawmi noohiw wazaadakum fil-khalqi bastah, fadhkuroo aalaa'allaahi la`allakum tuflihoon

verses.id-skb: Khatamallāhu ‘alā qulūbihim wa‘alā sam‘ihim, wa‘alā abṣārihim gisyāwatuw walahum ‘ażābun ‘aẓīm.
verses.en: Khatamallāhu ʿalā qulūbihim waʿalā samʿihim, waʿalā abṣārihim ghishāwatuw walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīm
verses.en-simple: Khatamallaahu `alaa quloobihim wa`alaa sam`ihim, wa`alaa absaarihim ghishaawatuw walahum `adhaabun `azeem

verses.id-skb: Lahū mu‘aqqibātum mim baini yadaihi wamin khalfihī yaḥfaẓūnahū min amrillāh, innallāha lā yugayyiru mā biqaumin ḥattā yugayyirū mā bi'anfusihim, wa iżā arādallāhu biqaumin sū'an falā maradda lah, wamā lahum min dūnihī miw wāl.
verses.en: Lahū muʿaqqibātum mim bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihī yaḥfaẓūnahū min amrillāh, innallāha lā yughayyiru mā biqawmin ḥattā yughayyirū mā biʾanfusihim, waʾidhā arādallāhu biqawmin sūʾan falā maradda lah, wamā lahum min dūnihī miw wāl
verses.en-simple: Lahoo mu`aqqibaatum mim bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihee yahfazoonahoo min amrillaah, innallaaha laa yughayyiru maa biqawmin hattaa yughayyiroo maa bi'anfusihim, wa'idhaa araadallaahu biqawmin soo'an falaa maradda lah, wamaa lahum min doonihee miw waal

verses.id-skb: Innallāha ya'murukum an tu'addul-amānāti ilā ahlihā wa iżā ḥakamtum bainan-nāsi an taḥkumū bil-‘adl, innallāha ni‘immā ya‘iẓukum bih, innallāha kāna samī‘am baṣīrā.
verses.en: Innallāha yaʾmurukum an tuʾaddul-amānāti ilā ahlihā waʾidhā ḥakamtum baynan-nāsi an taḥkumū bil-ʿadl, innallāha niʿimmā yaʿiẓukum bih, innallāha kāna samīʿam baṣīrā
verses.en-simple: Innallaaha ya'murukum an tu'addul-amaanaati ilaa ahlihaa wa'idhaa hakamtum baynan-naasi an tahkumoo bil-`adl, innallaaha ni`immaa ya`izukum bih, innallaaha kaana samee`am baseeraa

verses.id-skb: Qālū yāwailanā mam ba‘aṡanā mim marqadinā… hāżā mā wa‘adar-raḥmānu waṣadaqal-mursalūn.
verses.en: Qālū yāwaylanā mam baʿathanā mim marqadinā… hādhā mā waʿadar-raḥmānu waṣadaqal-mursalūn
verses.en-simple: Qaaloo yaawaylanaa mam ba`athanaa mim marqadinaa... haadhaa maa wa`adar-rahmaanu wasadaqal-mursaloon

verses.id-skb: Wal-waznu yauma'iżinil-ḥaqq, faman ṡaqulat mawāzīnuhū fa ulā'ika humul-mufliḥūn.
verses.en: Wal-waznu yawmaʾidhinil-ḥaqq, faman thaqulat mawāzīnuhū faʾulāʾika humul-mufliḥūn
verses.en-simple: Wal-waznu yawma'idhinil-haqq, faman thaqulat mawaazeenuhoo fa'ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon

verses.id-skb: Yauma tabyaḍḍu wujūhuw wataswaddu wujūh, fa ammal-lażīnaswaddat wujūhuhum, akafartum ba‘da īmānikum fażūqul-‘ażāba bimā kuntum takfurūn.
verses.en: Yawma tabyaḍḍu wujūhuw wataswaddu wujūh, faʾammal-ladhīnaswaddat wujūhuhum, akafartum baʿda īmānikum fadhūqul-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūn
verses.en-simple: Yawma tabyaddu wujoohuw wataswaddu wujooh, fa'ammal-ladheenaswaddat wujoohuhum, akafartum ba`da eemaanikum fadhooqul-`adhaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon

verses.id-skb: Fa in ḥājjūka faqul aslamtu wajhiya lillāhi wamanittaba‘an, waqul lillażīna ūtul-kitāba wal-ummiyyīna a'aslamtum, fa in aslamū faqadihtadau, wa in tawallau fa innamā ‘alaikal-balāg, wallāhu baṣīrum bil-‘ibād.
verses.en: Faʾin ḥājjūka faqul aslamtu wajhiya lillāhi wamanittabaʿan, waqul lilladhīna ūtul-kitāba wal-ummiyyīna aʾaslamtum, faʾin aslamū faqadihtadaw, waʾin tawallaw faʾinnamā ʿalaykal-balāgh, wallāhu baṣīrum bil-ʿibād
verses.en-simple: Fa'in haajjooka faqul aslamtu wajhiya lillaahi wamanittaba`an, waqul lilladheena ootul-kitaaba wal-ummiyyeena a'aslamtum, fa'in aslamoo faqadihtadaw, wa'in tawallaw fa'innamaa `alaykal-balaagh, wallaahu baseerum bil-`ibaad

rule: ta marbuta and tanwin at pause

verses.id-skb: Man żal-lażī yuqriḍullāha qarḍan ḥasanan fayuḍā‘ifahū lahū aḍ‘āfan kaṡīrah, wallāhu yaqbiḍu wayabsuṭ, wa ilaihi turja‘ūn.
verses.en: Man dhal-ladhī yuqriḍullāha qarḍan ḥasanan fayuḍāʿifahū lahū aḍʿāfan kathīrah, wallāhu yaqbiḍu wayabsuṭ, waʾilayhi turjaʿūn
verses.en-simple: Man dhal-ladhee yuqridullaaha qardan hasanan fayudaa`ifahoo lahoo ad`aafan katheerah, wallaahu yaqbidu wayabsut, wa'ilayhi turja`oon

verses.id-skb: Waqālarkabū fīhā bismillāhi majrêhā wamursāhā, inna rabbī lagafūrur raḥīm.
verses.en: Waqālarkabū fīhā bismillāhi majrēhā wamursāhā, inna rabbī laghafūrur raḥīm
verses.en-simple: Waqaalarkaboo feehaa bismillaahi majrayhaa wamursaahaa, inna rabbee laghafoorur raheem

verses.id-skb: Qālū yā abānā mā laka lā ta'mannā ‘alā yūsufa wa innā lahū lanāṣiḥūn.
verses.en: Qālū yāʾabānā mā laka lā taʾmannā ʿalā yūsufa waʾinnā lahū lanāṣiḥūn
verses.en-simple: Qaaloo yaa'abaanaa maa laka laa ta'mannaa `alaa yoosufa wa'innaa lahoo lanaasihoon

verses.id-skb: Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-lażī anzala ‘alā ‘abdihil-kitāba walam yaj‘al lahū ‘iwajā.
verses.en: Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī anzala ʿalā ʿabdihil-kitāba walam yajʿal lahū ʿiwajā
verses.en-simple: Al-hamdu lillaahil-ladhee anzala `alaa `abdihil-kitaaba walam yaj`al lahoo `iwajaa

verses.en-simple: Kallaa bal... raana `alaa quloobihim maa kaanoo yaksiboon

verses.id-skb: Walau ja‘alnāhu qur'ānan a‘jamiyyal laqālū laulā fuṣṣilat āyātuh, a'a‘jamiyyuw wa‘arabiyy, qul huwa lillażīna āmanū hudaw wasyifā', wal-lażīna lā yu'minūna fī āżānihim waqruw wahuwa ‘alaihim ‘amā, ulā'ika yunādauna mim makānim ba‘īd.
verses.en: Walaw jaʿalnāhu qurʾānan aʿjamiyyal laqālū lawlā fuṣṣilat āyātuh, aʾaʿjamiyyuw waʿarabiyy, qul huwa lilladhīna āmanū hudaw washifāʾ, wal-ladhīna lā yuʾminūna fī ādhānihim waqruw wahuwa ʿalayhim ʿamā, ulāʾika yunādawna mim makānim baʿīd
verses.en-simple: Walaw ja`alnaahu qur'aanan a`jamiyyal laqaaloo lawlaa fussilat aayaatuh, a'a`jamiyyuw wa`arabiyy, qul huwa lilladheena aamanoo hudaw washifaa', wal-ladheena laa yu'minoona fee aadhaanihim waqruw wahuwa `alayhim `amaa, ulaa'ika yunaadawna mim makaanim ba`eed

verses.id-skb: Yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanū lā yaskhar qaumum min qaumin ‘asā ay yakūnū khairam minhum walā nisā'um min nisā'in ‘asā ay yakunna khairam minhunn, walā talmizū anfusakum walā tanābazū bil-alqāb, bi'salismul-fusūqu ba‘dal-īmān, wamal lam yatub fa ulā'ika humuẓ-ẓālimūn.
verses.en: Yāʾayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū lā yaskhar qawmum min qawmin ʿasā ay yakūnū khayram minhum walā nisāʾum min nisāʾin ʿasā ay yakunna khayram minhunn, walā talmizū anfusakum walā tanābazū bil-alqāb, biʾsalismul-fusūqu baʿdal-īmān, wamal lam yatub faʾulāʾika humuẓ-ẓālimūn
verses.en-simple: Yaa'ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa yaskhar qawmum min qawmin `asaa ay yakoonoo khayram minhum walaa nisaa'um min nisaa'in `asaa ay yakunna khayram minhunn, walaa talmizoo anfusakum walaa tanaabazoo bil-alqaab, bi'salismul-fusooqu ba`dal-eemaan, wamal lam yatub fa'ulaa'ika humuz-zaalimoon

verses.id-skb: Alam nakhlukkum mim mā'im mahīn.
verses.en: Alam nakhlukkum mim māʾim mahīn
verses.en-simple: Alam nakhlukkum mim maa'im maheen

verses.en: Am ʿindahum khazāʾinu rabbika am humul-musayṭirūn
verses.en-simple: Am `indahum khazaa'inu rabbika am humul-musaytiroon

verses.id-skb: Iż jā'ūkum min fauqikum wamin asfala minkum wa iż zāgatil-abṣāru wabalagatil-qulūbul-ḥanājira wataẓunnūna billāhiẓ-ẓunūnā.
verses.en: Idh jāʾūkum min fawqikum wamin asfala minkum waʾidh zāghatil-abṣāru wabalaghatil-qulūbul-ḥanājira wataẓunnūna billāhiẓ-ẓunūnā
verses.en-simple: Idh jaa'ookum min fawqikum wamin asfala minkum wa'idh zaaghatil-absaaru wabalaghatil-quloobul-hanaajira watazunnoona billaahiz-zunoonaa

verses.id-skb: Innā a‘tadnā lil-kāfirīna salāsila wa aglālaw wasa‘īrā.
verses.en: Innā aʿtadnā lil-kāfirīna salāsila waʾaghlālaw wasaʿīrā
verses.en-simple: Innaa a`tadnaa lil-kaafireena salaasila wa'aghlaalaw wasa`eeraa

verses.id-skb: Faqad każżabū bil-ḥaqqi lammā jā'ahum, fasaufa ya'tīhim ambā'u mā kānū bihī yastahzi'ūn.
verses.en: Faqad kadhdhabū bil-ḥaqqi lammā jāʾahum, fasawfa yaʾtīhim ambāʾu mā kānū bihī yastahziʾūn
verses.en-simple: Faqad kadhdhaboo bil-haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum, fasawfa ya'teehim ambaa'u maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon

verses.en: Alif lām mīm ṣād

verses.en-simple: Alif laam meem raa, tilka aayaatul-kitaab, wal-ladhee unzila ilayka mir rabbikal-haqqu walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa yu'minoon

verses.en-simple: Taa seen, tilka aayaatul-qur'aani wakitaabim mubeen

verses.id-skb: Yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanū iżā tadāyantum bidainin ilā ajalim musamman faktubūh, walyaktub bainakum kātibum bil-‘adl, walā ya'ba kātibun ay yaktuba kamā ‘allamahullāhu falyaktub, walyumlilil-lażī ‘alaihil-ḥaqqu walyattaqillāha rabbahū walā yabkhas minhu syai'ā, fa in kānal-lażī ‘alaihil-ḥaqqu safīhan au ḍa‘īfan au lā yastaṭī‘u ay yumilla huwa falyumlil waliyyuhū bil-‘adl, wastasyhidū syahīdaini mir rijālikum, fa il lam yakūnā rajulaini farajuluw wamra'atāni mimman tarḍauna minasy-syuhadā'i an taḍilla iḥdāhumā fatużakkira iḥdāhumal-ukhrā, walā ya'basy-syuhadā'u iżā mā du‘ū, walā tas'amū an taktubūhu ṣagīran au kabīran ilā ajalih, żālikum aqsaṭu ‘indallāhi wa aqwamu lisy-syahādati wa adnā allā tartābū illā an takūna tijāratan ḥāḍiratan tudīrūnahā bainakum falaisa ‘alaikum junāḥun allā taktubūhā, wa asyhidū iżā tabāya‘tum, walā yuḍārra kātibuw walā syahīd, wa in taf‘alū fa innahū fusūqum bikum, wattaqullāh, wayu‘allimukumullāh, wallāhu bikulli syai'in ‘alīm.
verses.en: Yāʾayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū idhā tadāyantum bidaynin ilā ajalim musamman faktubūh, walyaktub baynakum kātibum bil-ʿadl, walā yaʾba kātibun ay yaktuba kamā ʿallamahullāhu falyaktub, walyumlilil-ladhī ʿalayhil-ḥaqqu walyattaqillāha rabbahū walā yabkhas minhu shayʾā, faʾin kānal-ladhī ʿalayhil-ḥaqqu safīhan aw ḍaʿīfan aw lā yastaṭīʿu ay yumilla huwa falyumlil waliyyuhū bil-ʿadl, wastashhidū shahīdayni mir rijālikum, faʾil lam yakūnā rajulayni farajuluw wamraʾatāni mimman tarḍawna minash-shuhadāʾi an taḍilla iḥdāhumā fatudhakkira iḥdāhumal-ukhrā, walā yaʾbash-shuhadāʾu idhā mā duʿū, walā tasʾamū an taktubūhu ṣaghīran aw kabīran ilā ajalih, dhālikum aqsaṭu ʿindallāhi waʾaqwamu lish-shahādati waʾadnā allā tartābū illā an takūna tijāratan ḥāḍiratan tudīrūnahā baynakum falaysa ʿalaykum junāḥun allā taktubūhā, waʾashhidū idhā tabāyaʿtum, walā yuḍārra kātibuw walā shahīd, waʾin tafʿalū faʾinnahū fusūqum bikum, wattaqullāh, wayuʿallimukumullāh, wallāhu bikulli shayʾin ʿalīm
verses.en-simple: Yaa'ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa tadaayantum bidaynin ilaa ajalim musamman faktubooh, walyaktub baynakum kaatibum bil-`adl, walaa ya'ba kaatibun ay yaktuba kamaa `allamahullaahu falyaktub, walyumlilil-ladhee `alayhil-haqqu walyattaqillaaha rabbahoo walaa yabkhas minhu shay'aa, fa'in kaanal-ladhee `alayhil-haqqu safeehan aw da`eefan aw laa yastatee`u ay yumilla huwa falyumlil waliyyuhoo bil-`adl, wastashhidoo shaheedayni mir rijaalikum, fa'il lam yakoonaa rajulayni farajuluw wamra'ataani mimman tardawna minash-shuhadaa'i an tadilla ihdaahumaa fatudhakkira ihdaahumal-ukhraa, walaa ya'bash-shuhadaa'u idhaa maa du`oo, walaa tas'amoo an taktuboohu sagheeran aw kabeeran ilaa ajalih, dhaalikum aqsatu `indallaahi wa'aqwamu lish-shahaadati wa'adnaa allaa tartaaboo illaa an takoona tijaaratan haadiratan tudeeroonahaa baynakum falaysa `alaykum junaahun allaa taktuboohaa, wa'ashhidoo idhaa tabaaya`tum, walaa yudaarra kaatibuw walaa shaheed, wa'in taf`aloo fa'innahoo fusooqum bikum, wattaqullaah, wayu`allimukumullaah, wallaahu bikulli shay'in `aleem

verses.id-skb: Lillāhi mā fis-samāwāti wamā fil-arḍ, wa in tubdū mā fī anfusikum au tukhfūhu yuḥāsibkum bihillāh, fayagfiru limay yasyā'u wayu‘ażżibu may yasyā', wallāhu ‘alā kulli syai'in qadīr.
verses.en: Lillāhi mā fis-samāwāti wamā fil-arḍ, waʾin tubdū mā fī anfusikum aw tukhfūhu yuḥāsibkum bihillāh, fayaghfiru limay yashāʾu wayuʿadhdhibu may yashāʾ, wallāhu ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
verses.en-simple: Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wa'in tubdoo maa fee anfusikum aw tukhfoohu yuhaasibkum bihillaah, fayaghfiru limay yashaa'u wayu`adhdhibu may yashaa', wallaahu `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer

verses.id-skb: Yūṣīkumullāhu fī aulādikum liż-żakari miṡlu ḥaẓẓil-unṡayain, fa in kunna nisā'an fauqaṡnataini falahunna ṡuluṡā mā tarak, wa in kānat wāḥidatan falahan-niṣf, wali'abawaihi likulli wāḥidim minhumas-sudusu mimmā taraka in kāna lahū walad, fa il lam yakul lahū waladuw wawariṡahū abawāhu fali'ummihiṡ-ṡuluṡ, fa in kāna lahū ikhwatun fali'ummihis-sudusu mim ba‘di waṣiyyatiy yūṣī bihā au dain, ābā'ukum wa abnā'ukum, lā tadrūna ayyuhum aqrabu lakum naf‘ā, farīḍatam minallāh, innallāha kāna ‘alīman ḥakīmā.
verses.en: Yūṣīkumullāhu fī awlādikum lidh-dhakari mithlu ḥaẓẓil-unthayayn, faʾin kunna nisāʾan fawqathnatayni falahunna thuluthā mā tarak, waʾin kānat wāḥidatan falahan-niṣf, waliʾabawayhi likulli wāḥidim minhumas-sudusu mimmā taraka in kāna lahū walad, faʾil lam yakul lahū waladuw wawarithahū abawāhu faliʾummihith-thuluth, faʾin kāna lahū ikhwatun faliʾummihis-sudusu mim baʿdi waṣiyyatiy yūṣī bihā aw dayn, ābāʾukum waʾabnāʾukum, lā tadrūna ayyuhum aqrabu lakum nafʿā, farīḍatam minallāh, innallāha kāna ʿalīman ḥakīmā
verses.en-simple: Yooseekumullaahu fee awlaadikum lidh-dhakari mithlu hazzil-unthayayn, fa'in kunna nisaa'an fawqathnatayni falahunna thuluthaa maa tarak, wa'in kaanat waahidatan falahan-nisf, wali'abawayhi likulli waahidim minhumas-sudusu mimmaa taraka in kaana lahoo walad, fa'il lam yakul lahoo waladuw wawarithahoo abawaahu fali'ummihith-thuluth, fa'in kaana lahoo ikhwatun fali'ummihis-sudusu mim ba`di wasiyyatiy yoosee bihaa aw dayn, aabaa'ukum wa'abnaa'ukum, laa tadroona ayyuhum aqrabu lakum naf`aa, fareedatam minallaah, innallaaha kaana `aleeman hakeemaa

verses.id-skb: Yastaftūnak, qulillāhu yuftīkum fil-kalālah, inimru'un halaka laisa lahū waladuw walahū ukhtun falahā niṣfu mā tarak, wahuwa yariṡuhā il lam yakul lahā walad, fa in kānataṡnataini falahumaṡ-ṡuluṡāni mimmā tarak, wa in kānū ikhwatar rijālaw wanisā'an faliż-żakari miṡlu ḥaẓẓil-unṡayain, yubayyinullāhu lakum an taḍillū, wallāhu bikulli syai'in ‘alīm.
verses.en: Yastaftūnak, qulillāhu yuftīkum fil-kalālah, inimruʾun halaka laysa lahū waladuw walahū ukhtun falahā niṣfu mā tarak, wahuwa yarithuhā il lam yakul lahā walad, faʾin kānatathnatayni falahumath-thuluthāni mimmā tarak, waʾin kānū ikhwatar rijālaw wanisāʾan falidh-dhakari mithlu ḥaẓẓil-unthayayn, yubayyinullāhu lakum an taḍillū, wallāhu bikulli shayʾin ʿalīm
verses.en-simple: Yastaftoonak, qulillaahu yufteekum fil-kalaalah, inimru'un halaka laysa lahoo waladuw walahoo ukhtun falahaa nisfu maa tarak, wahuwa yarithuhaa il lam yakul lahaa walad, fa'in kaanatathnatayni falahumath-thuluthaani mimmaa tarak, wa'in kaanoo ikhwatar rijaalaw wanisaa'an falidh-dhakari mithlu hazzil-unthayayn, yubayyinullaahu lakum an tadilloo, wallaahu bikulli shay'in `aleem

verses.id-skb: Allāhu nūrus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, maṡalu nūrihī kamisykātin fīhā miṣbāḥ, al-miṣbāḥu fī zujājah, az-zujājatu ka'annahā kaukabun durriyyuy yūqadu min syajaratim mubārakatin zaitūnatil lā syarqiyyatiw walā garbiyyatiy yakādu zaituhā yuḍī'u walau lam tamsashu nār, nūrun ‘alā nūr, yahdillāhu linūrihī may yasyā', wayaḍribullāhul-amṡāla lin-nās, wallāhu bikulli syai'in ‘alīm.
verses.en: Allāhu nūrus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, mathalu nūrihī kamishkātin fīhā miṣbāḥ, al-miṣbāḥu fī zujājah, az-zujājatu kaʾannahā kawkabun durriyyuy yūqadu min shajaratim mubārakatin zaytūnatil lā sharqiyyatiw walā gharbiyyatiy yakādu zaytuhā yuḍīʾu walaw lam tamsashu nār, nūrun ʿalā nūr, yahdillāhu linūrihī may yashāʾ, wayaḍribullāhul-amthāla lin-nās, wallāhu bikulli shayʾin ʿalīm
verses.en-simple: Allaahu noorus-samaawaati wal-ard, mathalu noorihee kamishkaatin feehaa misbaah, al-misbaahu fee zujaajah, az-zujaajatu ka'annahaa kawkabun durriyyuy yooqadu min shajaratim mubaarakatin zaytoonatil laa sharqiyyatiw walaa gharbiyyatiy yakaadu zaytuhaa yudee'u walaw lam tamsashu naar, noorun `alaa noor, yahdillaahu linoorihee may yashaa', wayadribullaahul-amthaala lin-naas, wallaahu bikulli shay'in `aleem
